lines.intro1: Captain! Bolt here, your co-pilot. Our rocket needs fuel to blast off.
lines.intro2: Fuel cells come in trays of ten. A full tray means full power.
lines.demo1: Watch me. This tray has seven cells. Seven needs three more to make ten.
lines.demo2: Three in, and it's full. Ten!
lines.l1_go: Your turn, Captain. Drag fuel cells in until the tray is full.
lines.l1_predict: New rule. Before we load it, tell me: how many more does this tray need?
lines.full3: Tray's full. The engines love it.
lines.over: Whoa! Too many! Fuel's spilling everywhere.
lines.under: Not quite. Look, there are still gaps in the tray.
lines.hint: Look at the empty gaps. What goes with this number to make ten?
lines.l2_intro: Mission part two. The scanner only flashes for a second. Don't count. Just look! How many cells?
lines.l2_tip: Top tip. A full row is five. So five, and two more, is seven.
lines.l3_intro: Final part. Launch countdown! Fill each tray as fast as you can.
lines.ready: Fuel tank full. Mission control, we are ready!
lines.best: And that's a new best time!
lines.next: Next stop, Planet Teen. See you there, Captain!
lines.welcome_back: Welcome back, Captain! Ready to beat your best?

mc_go.text: Mission control here. Fuel Up mission is go.

lines.bond_1: One needs nine more to make ten.
lines.bond_2: Two needs eight more to make ten.
lines.bond_3: Three needs seven more to make ten.
lines.bond_4: Four needs six more to make ten.
lines.bond_5: Five needs five more to make ten.

lines.bond_8: Eight needs two more to make ten.
lines.bond_9: Nine needs one more to make ten.
lines.seen_4: Four. One less than a full row.
